verdict.rationale: The skill-creator meta-skill explicitly guides creation, iterative improvement, benchmarking, and description optimization for new skills, and templates plus specification docs support packaging (SKILL.md structure, frontmatter, bundled files). missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the skill-creator meta-skill itself (community evidence covers skills usage/triggering generally, not authoring workflow specifically), and no evidence of packaging/distribution steps (e.g., plugin marketplace publishing) being driven directly by the meta-skill.
